requirement: Build a health-check API with GET /health returning status, app version and current server time.
Build a REST API for a todo list with create, list, update and delete.
Build a notes API with create, list, get, update and delete, storing notes in SQLite.
Build a URL shortener API that creates short codes for URLs, redirects short codes to the original URL, and counts clicks per link.
Build an inventory API to add, update and remove products with name, SKU, quantity and price, validate inputs, and list products whose quantity is below a given threshold.
Build a bookmarks API where each bookmark has a URL, title and tags, with endpoints to add, delete and list bookmarks filtered by tag.
Build a task management API with user registration, login, and task create/update/delete and status management. Users must only see their own tasks.
Build a library loans API: manage books and members, lend a book with a due date, return it, prevent lending a book that is already out, and list overdue loans.
Build an expense tracker API with categories, expenses with amount and date, and an endpoint returning monthly totals per category.
Build an event booking API: create events with a capacity, book and cancel seats, and reject bookings when an event is full.
